aggregation_definitions.mean_per_sample: arithmetic mean of per-sample metrics; used for paired bootstrap, ablation, and subgroup figures
aggregation_definitions.pooled_global: metrics derived from physical-array sufficient-statistic totals; used for overall and per-role metric figures

label: Synthetic benchmark only - No external generalization claim

uncertainty.coverage_note: mean_per_sample_pixel_coverage is the arithmetic mean of sample interior-pixel coverages and equals pooled pixel coverage when all samples have equal valid interior-pixel counts
uncertainty.lower_bound_clipping_policy: lower bounds are clipped to physical source value 0; upper bounds are not clipped
uncertainty.standard_deviation_floor_policy: max(predictive_std, std_floor) is used for calibration scores and interval radii
